fusions.name: Armful of Scree
fusions.desc: Throws 3 stones at once from three arms, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Boulder Heave
fusions.desc: Heaves a boulder held in every arm at the first enemy it meets, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Cairn Wall
fusions.desc: Piles stones into a wall 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Rock Among Rocks
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 10% earth resistance.
